---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m1p3t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgeons, Slots

ASSUME Surgeons = 1 .. 3

VARIABLES token, book, crashed, passes

vars == <<token, book, crashed, passes>>

RingNext(s) == (s % 3) + 1

BookedSlots == { r.slot : r \in book }

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Surgeons
    /\ book \subseteq [ slot : Slots, by : Surgeons ]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Surgeons
    /\ passes \in 0 .. 6

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ book = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ passes = 0

Claim(s) ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ s \notin BookedSlots
    /\ book' = book \cup { [ slot |-> s, by |-> token ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, crashed, passes >>

Pass ==
    /\ token \notin crashed
    /\ passes < 6
    /\ token' = RingNext(token)
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << book, crashed >>

Crash(x) ==
    /\ x \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 2
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup { x }
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, book, passes >>

SkipCrashed ==
    /\ token \in crashed
    /\ passes < 6
    /\ token' = RingNext(token)
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << book, crashed >>

Halt ==
    /\ passes = 6
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Claim(s)
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E x \in Surgeons : Crash(x)
    \/ SkipCrashed
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleBooking ==
    \A r1, r2 \in book : r1.slot = r2.slot => r1.by = r2.by
=============================================================================
nl:
A hospital coordinates its operating rooms with a token that circulates among the on-call surgeons arranged in a fixed ring. Only the surgeon currently holding the token may claim an operating-room slot, and once a slot is claimed it belongs to that surgeon for the rest of the day. When the token holder is done it passes the token to the next surgeon around the ring. A surgeon can crash silently at any time -- they simply stop responding -- so the coordinator may skip a crashed holder by advancing the token past them. The scheduler must guarantee that the same operating-room slot is never handed to two different surgeons, even as the token moves and surgeons drop out. Claims form an append-only booking log, and the guard that a slot is still free is what keeps bookings consistent. Recovery from a crashed holder must not itself cause a slot to be double-booked.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every operating-room slot that appears in the booking log is associated with exactly one surgeon, so no slot is ever booked by two different surgeons.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m6p4t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Courses, Students, MaxCap, LeaseLen, MaxT

VARIABLES enrolled, leases, cap, clock

vars == <<enrolled, leases, cap, clock>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ enrolled \in [ Courses -> SUBSET Students ]
    /\ leases \subseteq [ course : Courses, student : Students, deadline : 0 .. MaxT + LeaseLen ]
    /\ cap \in [ Courses -> 0 .. MaxCap ]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT

Init ==
    /\ enrolled = [ c \in Courses |-> {} ]
    /\ leases = {}
    /\ cap = [ c \in Courses |-> 1 ]
    /\ clock = 0

Register(c, s) ==
    /\ s \notin enrolled[c]
    /\ Cardinality(enrolled[c]) < cap[c]
    /\ enrolled' = [ enrolled EXCEPT ![c] = @ \cup { s } ]
    /\ leases' = leases \cup { [ course |-> c, student |-> s, deadline |-> clock + LeaseLen ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, clock >>

ExpireLease(r) ==
    /\ r \in leases
    /\ r.deadline <= clock
    /\ enrolled' = [ enrolled EXCEPT ![r.course] = @ \ { r.student } ]
    /\ leases' = leases \ { r }
    /\ UNCHANGED << cap, clock >>

AdjustCap(c, k) ==
    /\ k >= Cardinality(enrolled[c])
    /\ cap' = [ cap EXCEPT ![c] = k ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << enrolled, leases, clock >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << enrolled, leases, cap >>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Courses, s \in Students : Register(c, s)
    \/ \E r \in leases : ExpireLease(r)
    \/ \E c \in Courses, k \in 0 .. MaxCap : AdjustCap(c, k)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
    \A c \in Courses : Cardinality(enrolled[c]) <= cap[c]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Courses = {c1, c2}
    Students = {s1, s2}
    MaxCap = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxT = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A university runs online course registration where each seat a student takes is a time-limited lease rather than a permanent hold. When a student registers for a course, they receive a lease that expires after a fixed number of ticks unless renewed, at which point the seat is automatically released back to the pool. The registrar may adjust a course's capacity at runtime -- opening extra seats when a larger room is found, or trimming seats -- but may never trim capacity below the number of students currently enrolled. A student may only be enrolled in a course if a free seat exists under the course's current capacity. As the clock advances, expired leases free their seats so other students can register. The system must guarantee that at no point does the number of enrolled students in any course exceed that course's current capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every course, the number of currently enrolled students never exceeds that course's current capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p2t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Fleet

VARIABLES amount, ver, msgs, granted

vars == <<amount, ver, msgs, granted>>

Places == { "holding", "runway", "departed" }

TypeOK ==
    /\ amount \in [ Places -> 0 .. Fleet ]
    /\ ver \in 0 .. Fleet
    /\ msgs \subseteq [ saw : 0 .. Fleet ]
    /\ granted \in 0 .. Fleet

Init ==
    /\ amount = [ p \in Places |-> IF p = "holding" THEN Fleet ELSE 0 ]
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ granted = 0

Submit ==
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup { [ saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << amount, ver, granted >>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.saw = ver
    /\ amount["holding"] > 0
    /\ amount' = [ amount EXCEPT !["holding"] = @ - 1, !["runway"] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ granted' = granted + 1
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ { m }

Refresh(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.saw # ver
    /\ msgs' = (msgs \ { m }) \cup { [ saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << amount, ver, granted >>

Depart ==
    /\ amount["runway"] > 0
    /\ amount' = [ amount EXCEPT !["runway"] = @ - 1, !["departed"] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, msgs, granted >>

Next ==
    \/ Submit
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Grant(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Refresh(m)
    \/ Depart

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FleetConserved ==
    amount["holding"] + amount["runway"] + amount["departed"] = Fleet
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Fleet = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FleetConserved
nl:
An air-traffic system allocates a single landing runway among inbound aircraft using optimistic concurrency. Aircraft begin in a holding pattern; a controller submits landing requests, each stamped with the runway's version number as seen at submission time. Because requests travel over a network they may be delivered and processed in any order. When a request is processed, it succeeds only if its stamped version still matches the runway's current version -- a compare-and-set -- in which case one aircraft moves from holding onto the runway and the version is bumped. A request whose stamp is stale is refreshed with the current version and retried later. Aircraft on the runway eventually depart. No aircraft is ever created or lost: the total number of aircraft across the holding pattern, the runway, and the departed area is invariant throughout.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of aircraft, summed over the holding pattern, the runway, and the departed area, always equals the fixed fleet size.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m9p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Stations, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES assign, robotEpoch, epoch, syncs

vars == <<assign, robotEpoch, epoch, syncs>>

Occupancy(st) == Cardinality({ r \in Robots : assign[r] = st })

Cap == [ s \in Stations |-> IF s = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 ]

TypeOK ==
    /\ assign \in [ Robots -> Stations \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ robotEpoch \in [ Robots -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ syncs \in 0 .. 6

Init ==
    /\ assign = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ robotEpoch = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ syncs = 0

Dock(r, st) ==
    /\ assign[r] = 0
    /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
    /\ Occupancy(st) < Cap[st]
    /\ assign' = [ assign EXCEPT ![r] = st ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << robotEpoch, epoch, syncs >>

Undock(r) ==
    /\ assign[r] # 0
    /\ assign' = [ assign EXCEPT ![r] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << robotEpoch, epoch, syncs >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assign, robotEpoch, syncs >>

Sync(r) ==
    /\ robotEpoch[r] < epoch
    /\ syncs < 6
    /\ robotEpoch' = [ robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch ]
    /\ syncs' = syncs + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assign, epoch >>

Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots, st \in Stations : Dock(r, st)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Undock(r)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityOK ==
    \A st \in Stations : Occupancy(st) <= Cap[st]
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
    Stations = {1, 2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl:
A warehouse runs a fleet of mobile robots that dock at charging stations, where each station can hold only a bounded number of robots at once. The fleet is periodically reconfigured: a coordinator bumps a global epoch number that redefines dock assignments, and every robot carries the epoch it last synced to. A robot may only claim a dock once it has synced to the current epoch, so a robot running on a stale epoch must catch up first. Robots can be slow -- a straggler may lag several epochs behind before it syncs -- but no robot ever fails outright; a lagging robot always remains able to sync and eventually act. Docking, undocking, reconfiguration, and syncing all interleave freely. The controller must ensure that no charging station ever holds more robots than its fixed capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every charging station, the number of robots currently docked there never exceeds that station's fixed capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m8p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Agents, Zones, Chutes, Bags

ZoneOf(c) == IF c <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES zoneLock, chuteLock, log, admin

vars == <<zoneLock, chuteLock, log, admin>>

Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s }

TypeOK ==
    /\ zoneLock \in [ Zones -> Agents \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ chuteLock \in [ Chutes -> Agents \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ log \in Seq(Bags)
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ zoneLock = [ z \in Zones |-> 0 ]
    /\ chuteLock = [ c \in Chutes |-> 0 ]
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ admin = FALSE

AcquireZone(a, z) ==
    /\ zoneLock[z] = 0
    /\ zoneLock' = [ zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = a ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << chuteLock, log, admin >>

AcquireChute(a, c) ==
    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(c)] = a
    /\ chuteLock[c] = 0
    /\ chuteLock' = [ chuteLock EXCEPT ![c] = a ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, log, admin >>

ReleaseLocks(a) ==
    /\ zoneLock' = [ z \in Zones |-> IF zoneLock[z] = a THEN 0 ELSE zoneLock[z] ]
    /\ chuteLock' = [ c \in Chutes |-> IF chuteLock[c] = a THEN 0 ELSE chuteLock[c] ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << log, admin >>

Dispatch(a, bag) ==
    /\ \E c \in Chutes : chuteLock[c] = a /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(c)] = a
    /\ bag \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, bag)
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, admin >>

AdminDispatch(bag) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ bag \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, bag)
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << zoneLock, chuteLock, log >>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, z \in Zones : AcquireZone(a, z)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, c \in Chutes : AcquireChute(a, c)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : ReleaseLocks(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, bag \in Bags : Dispatch(a, bag)
    \/ \E bag \in Bags : AdminDispatch(bag)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleDispatch ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN log : log[i] = log[j] => i = j
=============================================================================
nl:
An airport baggage router dispatches bags to departing aircraft through a two-level locking discipline. To work in a sorting area an agent must first take the coarse lock on a whole zone, and only then may it take the fine lock on an individual chute within that zone; a chute lock is never legitimately held without the enclosing zone lock. Dispatching a bag onto its aircraft is irreversible -- once a bag is dispatched it is physically gone -- so a bag must be dispatched at most once, and a normal dispatch is permitted only by an agent holding both the chute and its zone. A privileged administrator can override the hierarchy and force a bag out directly, but even the override must respect the at-most-once rule and never dispatch a bag that has already left. Agents may release their locks, and the admin channel can be toggled on and off. The dispatch log records the bags sent, in order.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No bag ever appears more than once in the dispatch log, so every bag is dispatched at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m2p1t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Banks

VARIABLES vote, decision, pstate, ledger

vars == <<vote, decision, pstate, ledger>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ vote \in [ Banks -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ]
    /\ decision \in { "none", "commit", "abort" }
    /\ pstate \in [ Banks -> { "working", "committed", "aborted" } ]
    /\ ledger \in [ Banks -> { "absent", "posted" } ]

Init ==
    /\ vote = [ b \in Banks |-> "none" ]
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ pstate = [ b \in Banks |-> "working" ]
    /\ ledger = [ b \in Banks |-> "absent" ]

CastVote(b, v) ==
    /\ vote[b] = "none"
    /\ v \in { "yes", "no" }
    /\ vote' = [ vote EXCEPT ![b] = v ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << decision, pstate, ledger >>

Decide ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \A b \in Banks : vote[b] # "none"
    /\ decision' = IF \A b \in Banks : vote[b] = "yes" THEN "commit" ELSE "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, pstate, ledger >>

CommitBank(b) ==
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ pstate[b] = "working"
    /\ pstate' = [ pstate EXCEPT ![b] = "committed" ]
    /\ ledger' = [ ledger EXCEPT ![b] = "posted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, decision >>

AbortBank(b) ==
    /\ decision = "abort"
    /\ pstate[b] = "working"
    /\ pstate' = [ pstate EXCEPT ![b] = "aborted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << vote, decision, ledger >>

Idle ==
    /\ decision # "none"
    /\ \A b \in Banks : pstate[b] # "working"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks, v \in { "yes", "no" } : CastVote(b, v)
    \/ Decide
    \/ \E b \in Banks : CommitBank(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AbortBank(b)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    \A b \in Banks : pstate[b] = "committed" => ledger[b] = "posted"
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {1, 2, 3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
An interbank settlement runs a batch as a two-phase commit across several member banks. In the voting phase the coordinator collects a yes/no vote from each participant; a slow bank may take its time to respond, but no bank fails outright -- every participant remains able to vote and is eventually heard. Once all votes are in, the coordinator decides: commit if every vote was yes, otherwise abort. On a commit decision, each participating bank atomically transitions to committed and posts its contribution to the shared settlement ledger in the same step, so a committed update can never be lost. On an abort decision, participants move to aborted and post nothing. The critical guarantee is that the shared ledger never loses an update: any bank recorded as committed has its contribution posted to the ledger.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every participant in the committed state has its contribution posted to the shared settlement ledger, so no committed update is ever lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m6p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, Lobbies, MaxT, Lease

VARIABLES owner, expiry, clock, openL

vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, openL>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [ Lobbies -> Players \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ expiry \in [ Lobbies -> 0 .. MaxT + Lease ]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT
    /\ openL \subseteq Lobbies

Init ==
    /\ owner = [ l \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ expiry = [ l \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ openL = Lobbies

Claim(p, l) ==
    /\ l \in openL
    /\ owner[l] = 0
    /\ owner' = [ owner EXCEPT ![l] = p ]
    /\ expiry' = [ expiry EXCEPT ![l] = clock + Lease ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, openL >>

Expire(l) ==
    /\ owner[l] # 0
    /\ expiry[l] <= clock
    /\ owner' = [ owner EXCEPT ![l] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << expiry, clock, openL >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, openL >>

OpenLobby(l) ==
    /\ l \notin openL
    /\ openL' = openL \cup { l }
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, clock >>

CloseLobby(l) ==
    /\ l \in openL
    /\ owner[l] = 0
    /\ openL' = openL \ { l }
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, expiry, clock >>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : Claim(p, l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Expire(l)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : OpenLobby(l)
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : CloseLobby(l)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeaseWithinCapacity ==
    \A l \in Lobbies : owner[l] # 0 => l \in openL
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Players = {1, 2}
    Lobbies = {1, 2}
    MaxT = 3
    Lease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaseWithinCapacity
nl:
A multiplayer game matchmaker hands out game lobbies, each of which is a critical resource that at most one player may own at a time. Ownership is granted as a time-limited lease: when a player claims a free, open lobby they hold it until the lease expires on the shared clock, after which the lobby is released back to the pool. The set of open lobbies changes at runtime -- operators bring extra lobby servers online under load and take them offline when demand falls -- but a lobby may only be taken offline while it is unowned, so capacity never shrinks out from under an active player. A player may only claim a lobby that is currently open and free. The matchmaker must guarantee that no player ever holds a lease on a lobby that is not part of the currently open capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any lobby that is currently owned under a lease is always one of the currently open lobbies, so no player holds the critical resource outside live capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m5p6t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Authorized, Actions, Quorum, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES proposal, votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed

vars == <<proposal, votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposal \in Actions \cup { "none" }
    /\ votes \subseteq [ robot : Robots ]
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ robotEpoch \in [ Robots -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]
    /\ executed \subseteq Actions

Init ==
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ robotEpoch = [ r \in Robots |-> 0 ]
    /\ executed = {}

Propose(a) ==
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ a \notin executed
    /\ proposal' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, epoch, robotEpoch, executed >>

CastVote(r) ==
    /\ proposal # "none"
    /\ r \in Authorized
    /\ robotEpoch[r] = epoch
    /\ votes' = votes \cup { [ robot |-> r ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, epoch, robotEpoch, executed >>

Execute ==
    /\ proposal # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ executed' = executed \cup { proposal }
    /\ proposal' = "none"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, robotEpoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, robotEpoch, executed >>

Sync(r) ==
    /\ robotEpoch[r] < epoch
    /\ robotEpoch' = [ robotEpoch EXCEPT ![r] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, votes, epoch, executed >>

Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ proposal = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Actions : Propose(a)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : CastVote(r)
    \/ Execute
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthorizedFreshVotes ==
    \A v \in votes : v.robot \in Authorized /\ robotEpoch[v.robot] = epoch
=============================================================================
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet commits each fleet-wide action only after a quorum of robots votes to approve it. A coordinator proposes an action; robots then cast approval votes, and because votes travel over a shared radio they may arrive and be tallied in any order. A vote counts only if it comes from an authorized fleet member that is synced to the current configuration epoch: unauthorized robots have no say, and a robot lagging on a stale epoch must resync before its vote is valid. When the tally of valid votes reaches the quorum, the proposed action is executed. Reconfiguration bumps the epoch and discards any votes gathered under the old configuration, since they are now stale. The fleet must guarantee that every vote standing in the current tally comes from an authorized member that is current with the present epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every vote in the current tally comes from an authorized fleet member whose synced epoch equals the current configuration epoch.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Books, Instances, MaxVer

VARIABLES available, reserved, version, reqs

vars == <<available, reserved, version, reqs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ available \in [ Books -> BOOLEAN ]
    /\ reserved \in [ Books -> Instances \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ version \in [ Books -> 0 .. MaxVer ]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ inst : Instances, book : Books, saw : 0 .. MaxVer ]

Init ==
    /\ available = [ b \in Books |-> TRUE ]
    /\ reserved = [ b \in Books |-> 0 ]
    /\ version = [ b \in Books |-> 0 ]
    /\ reqs = {}

Submit(i, b) ==
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup { [ inst |-> i, book |-> b, saw |-> version[b] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << available, reserved, version >>

Apply(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw = version[q.book]
    /\ available[q.book] = TRUE
    /\ version[q.book] < MaxVer
    /\ available' = [ available EXCEPT ![q.book] = FALSE ]
    /\ reserved' = [ reserved EXCEPT ![q.book] = q.inst ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![q.book] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { q }

Stale(q) ==
    /\ q \in reqs
    /\ q.saw # version[q.book]
    /\ reqs' = (reqs \ { q }) \cup { [ inst |-> q.inst, book |-> q.book, saw |-> version[q.book] ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << available, reserved, version >>

Return(b) ==
    /\ reserved[b] # 0
    /\ version[b] < MaxVer
    /\ available' = [ available EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE ]
    /\ reserved' = [ reserved EXCEPT ![b] = 0 ]
    /\ version' = [ version EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Books : Submit(i, b)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Apply(q)
    \/ \E q \in reqs : Stale(q)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Return(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RecordConsistent ==
    \A b \in Books : (reserved[b] # 0) <=> (available[b] = FALSE)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Books = {b1, b2}
    Instances = {1, 2}
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RecordConsistent
nl:
Two independent branch servers share a single pool of library books and reserve them using optimistic concurrency. Each book carries a version number and a paired availability flag and reservation holder that together form its shared record. To reserve a book, a branch submits a request stamped with the version it last saw. When a request is applied it succeeds only if its stamped version still matches the book's current version -- a compare-and-set -- at which point the book is atomically marked unavailable and assigned to the requesting branch, and the version is bumped. A request whose stamp is stale lost the race to the other branch and is refreshed and retried. Returning a book atomically frees it and bumps the version again. Because two branches race on the same pool, the optimistic check is what prevents a lost update. The record must stay internally consistent: a book is reserved exactly when it is unavailable.

    /\ regionLock' = [ regionLock EXCEPT ![rg] = p ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lobbyLock, session, epoch >>

AcquireLobby(p, lb) ==
    /\ p \in Authorized
    /\ session[p] = epoch
    /\ regionLock[RegionOf(lb)] = p
    /\ lobbyLock[lb] = 0
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lobbyLock EXCEPT ![lb] = p ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, session, epoch >>

ReleaseAll(p) ==
    /\ regionLock' = [ rg \in Regions |-> IF regionLock[rg] = p THEN 0 ELSE regionLock[rg] ]
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lb \in Lobbies |-> IF lobbyLock[lb] = p THEN 0 ELSE lobbyLock[lb] ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << session, epoch >>

BumpEpoch ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ regionLock' = [ rg \in Regions |-> 0 ]
    /\ lobbyLock' = [ lb \in Lobbies |-> 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED session

Renew(p) ==
    /\ p \in Authorized
    /\ session[p] < epoch
    /\ session' = [ session EXCEPT ![p] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, lobbyLock, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, rg \in Regions : AcquireRegion(p, rg)
    \/ \E p \in Players, lb \in Lobbies : AcquireLobby(p, lb)
    \/ \E p \in Players : ReleaseAll(p)
    \/ BumpEpoch
    \/ \E p \in Players : Renew(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleUnauthorizedLocks ==
    /\ \A rg \in Regions : regionLock[rg] # 0 =>
           ( regionLock[rg] \in Authorized /\ session[regionLock[rg]] = epoch )
    /\ \A lb \in Lobbies : lobbyLock[lb] # 0 =>
           ( lobbyLock[lb] \in Authorized
             /\ session[lobbyLock[lb]] = epoch
             /\ regionLock[RegionOf(lb)] = lobbyLock[lb] )
=============================================================================

A multiplayer matchmaker is run by two independent server instances that share one pool of lobbies, grouped into regions. To work on a lobby a player must take locks hierarchically: first the coarse lock on the lobby's region, and only then the fine lock on the lobby itself, so a held lobby lock always sits under a region lock held by the same player. Only an authorized player with a current session may take a lock; a player whose session has gone stale must renew before acting, and unauthorized players may never lock anything. A global epoch bump starts a new matchmaking round: it releases every lock and makes all sessions stale until players renew. Players may release the locks they hold. The matchmaker must guarantee that every held lock belongs to an authorized player with a current session, and that every fine lobby lock is backed by the same player's region lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every held region or lobby lock belongs to an authorized player whose session is current, and every held lobby lock is backed by the same player holding the enclosing region lock.

A print shop spooler accepts jobs from two independent submitter instances that share one bounded spool queue and a single printer. The queue applies backpressure: a submit is refused whenever the queue is already at capacity, so it never overflows. Each job has a status in a shared record that must stay consistent with where the job physically is. Submitting a job appends it to the shared queue and atomically marks its status queued in the same step. The printer starts a job by taking the head of the queue, and when it finishes it atomically moves the job into the printed set and marks its status printed together. Because the status record and the physical location are updated in lockstep, no status update to the shared record is ever lost: a queued job reads queued, and a printed job reads printed and is in the printed set. Both submitter instances draw on the same queue and printer.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m7p0t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Workers, MaxChunks

VARIABLES lock, inCS, reqs, chunks

vars == <<lock, inCS, reqs, chunks>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in Workers \cup { 0 }
    /\ inCS \in [ Workers -> BOOLEAN ]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ worker : Workers ]
    /\ chunks \in 0 .. MaxChunks

Init ==
    /\ lock = 0
    /\ inCS = [ w \in Workers |-> FALSE ]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ chunks = 0

Request(w) ==
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup { [ worker |-> w ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << lock, inCS, chunks >>

ApplyCAS(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ lock = 0
    /\ lock' = m.worker
    /\ inCS' = [ inCS EXCEPT ![m.worker] = TRUE ]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { m }
    /\ UNCHANGED chunks

FailCAS(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ lock # 0
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { m }
    /\ UNCHANGED << lock, inCS, chunks >>

Print(w) ==
    /\ inCS[w] = TRUE
    /\ chunks < MaxChunks
    /\ chunks' = chunks + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << lock, inCS, reqs >>

Release(w) ==
    /\ inCS[w] = TRUE
    /\ lock' = 0
    /\ inCS' = [ inCS EXCEPT ![w] = FALSE ]
    /\ chunks' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Request(w)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : ApplyCAS(m)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : FailCAS(m)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Print(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Release(w)

    MaxChunks = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CSMatchesLock
nl:
A print shop shares one printer among several worker threads, and the printer is a critical resource guarded by a compare-and-swap lock register that holds either zero (free) or the id of the owning worker. To grab the printer a worker issues a CAS acquire request; applying it succeeds only if the register currently reads zero, in which case it is swapped to that worker's id and the worker enters the printing critical section. If the register is already owned the CAS fails and the worker simply retries later -- a worker may be slow, taking its time between attempts and between print chunks, but it never fails outright and always remains able to retry. While in the critical section a worker prints in bounded chunks, then releases the printer by resetting the register to zero and leaving the critical section. The shop must guarantee mutual exclusion: the set of workers currently printing is exactly the singleton owner named by the lock register, or empty when the register is free.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The set of workers currently in the printing critical section is empty when the lock register is free and is exactly the single worker named by the register otherwise, so at most one worker ever prints at a time.

EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

CONSTANTS Base, MaxCap, MaxVer

RECURSIVE SumSeq(_)
SumSeq(s) == IF s = << >> THEN 0 ELSE Head(s) + SumSeq(Tail(s))

VARIABLES stock, ver, ledger, capacity, reqs

vars == <<stock, ver, ledger, capacity, reqs>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ ver \in 0 .. MaxVer
    /\ ledger \in Seq({ -1, 1 })
    /\ capacity \in 0 .. MaxCap
    /\ reqs \subseteq [ delta : { -1, 1 }, saw : 0 .. MaxVer ]

Init ==
    /\ stock = Base
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ ledger = << >>
    /\ capacity = 2
    /\ reqs = {}

Submit(d) ==
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup { [ delta |-> d, saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << stock, ver, ledger, capacity >>

ApplyCAS(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ m.saw = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ stock + m.delta >= 0
    /\ stock + m.delta <= capacity
    /\ stock' = stock + m.delta
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ ledger' = Append(ledger, m.delta)
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ { m }
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

StaleCAS(m) ==
    /\ m \in reqs
    /\ m.saw # ver
    /\ reqs' = (reqs \ { m }) \cup { [ delta |-> m.delta, saw |-> ver ] }
    /\ UNCHANGED << stock, ver, ledger, capacity >>

AdjustCap(k) ==
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED << stock, ver, ledger, reqs >>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in { -1, 1 } : Submit(d)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : ApplyCAS(m)
    \/ \E m \in reqs : StaleCAS(m)
    \/ \E k \in 0 .. MaxCap : AdjustCap(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    stock = Base + SumSeq(ledger)
=============================================================================

    Base = 1
    MaxCap = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps the unit count of a blood type in a shared stock register, updated concurrently through a compare-and-swap protocol. Each update is a donation of one unit or a dispense of one unit, submitted as a request stamped with the version the submitter last saw. Applying a request succeeds only if its stamped version still matches the register's current version -- a compare-and-set -- and only if the resulting stock stays within zero and the current capacity; on success the stock changes by the delta, the version is bumped, and the delta is appended to an audit ledger in the same atomic step. A stale request whose version no longer matches is refreshed and retried. The storage capacity changes at runtime as fridges are added or taken offline. Because the register and the ledger advance together, no update is ever lost: the stock always equals the base level plus the sum of every applied delta in the ledger.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The stock register always equals the base level plus the sum of all deltas recorded in the audit ledger, so no applied donation or dispense update is ever lost.

    /\ UNCHANGED << token, departed, capacity, passes >>

    /\ f \notin departed
    /\ departed' = departed \cup { f }
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, cleared, capacity, passes >>

    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, cleared, departed, passes >>

    \/ \E f \in Flights : Clear(f)
    \/ \E f \in Flights : Depart(f)

An air-traffic runway allocator passes a single control token around a ring of tower controllers; only the controller currently holding the token may clear a flight. Clearing a flight for takeoff is granted at most once per flight -- it is guarded so an already-cleared flight is never cleared again -- and a flight may be cleared only while the number of flights cleared but not yet departed stays under the current runway capacity. Departing is the irreversible action: a flight actually leaves the ground, and a flight may depart only if it was previously cleared, so no flight ever departs without its one-time clearance. The runway capacity changes at runtime as runways are opened or closed for weather. The token advances around the ring so control rotates fairly. The allocator must guarantee that the set of departed flights is always a subset of the flights that were cleared, so the irreversible departure is always backed by a prior single clearance.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every flight that has departed was previously cleared for takeoff, so the irreversible departure never occurs without the flight's one-time clearance.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Bays, Cars, MaxT, LeaseLen

VARIABLES assigned, lease, results, clock, crashed

TypeOK ==
    /\ assigned \in [ Bays -> Cars \cup { 0 } ]
    /\ lease \in [ Bays -> 0 .. MaxT + LeaseLen ]
    /\ results \in [ Cars -> { "pending", "clean" } ]
    /\ clock \in 0 .. MaxT
    /\ crashed \subseteq Bays

Init ==
    /\ assigned = [ b \in Bays |-> 0 ]
    /\ lease = [ b \in Bays |-> 0 ]
    /\ results = [ c \in Cars |-> "pending" ]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Assign(b, c) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ assigned[b] = 0
    /\ results[c] = "pending"
    /\ \A b2 \in Bays : assigned[b2] # c
    /\ assigned' = [ assigned EXCEPT ![b] = c ]
    /\ lease' = [ lease EXCEPT ![b] = clock + LeaseLen ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << results, clock, crashed >>

Finish(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ assigned[b] # 0
    /\ lease[b] > clock
    /\ results' = [ results EXCEPT ![assigned[b]] = "clean" ]
    /\ assigned' = [ assigned EXCEPT ![b] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lease, clock, crashed >>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = { b }
    /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, lease, results, clock >>

Reclaim(b) ==
    /\ assigned[b] # 0
    /\ (lease[b] <= clock \/ b \in crashed)
    /\ assigned' = [ assigned EXCEPT ![b] = 0 ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lease, results, clock, crashed >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, lease, results, crashed >>

Idle ==
    /\ \A c \in Cars : results[c] = "clean"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ \E b \in Bays : Finish(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Crash(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Reclaim(b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CleanIsStable ==
    \A c \in Cars : results[c] = "clean" => \A b \in Bays : assigned[b] # c

    Cars = {c1, c2}
    MaxT = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CleanIsStable

A car-wash conveyor line assigns cars to wash bays under time-limited leases. A bay may take an unwashed car only if the car is still pending, no other bay already holds it, and the bay is not crashed; taking it stamps a lease deadline on the shared clock. When a bay finishes, it atomically marks the car clean in the shared results record and releases it in the same step, so a completed wash is durably recorded. One bay may crash silently: it keeps its current assignment but stops finishing work. Its assignment is then reclaimed -- as is any bay's expired lease -- so the car returns to the pool to be reassigned to another bay and finished, and the pending wash is retried, never lost. Crucially, once a car is recorded clean it stays clean and is never taken by any bay again, so a completed update to the results record is never reverted or lost. Time advances tick by tick, expiring stale leases.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any car recorded clean in the shared results record is held by no bay, so a completed wash is never reassigned, reverted, or lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m9p2t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Branches, Total, MaxEpoch

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ { x })

VARIABLES atBranch, inTransit, epoch, branchEpoch

vars == <<atBranch, inTransit, epoch, branchEpoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ atBranch \in [ Branches -> 0 .. Total ]
    /\ inTransit \in 0 .. Total
    /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
    /\ branchEpoch \in [ Branches -> 0 .. MaxEpoch ]

Init ==
    /\ atBranch = [ b \in Branches |-> IF b = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0 ]
    /\ inTransit = 0
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ branchEpoch = [ b \in Branches |-> 0 ]

Ship(b) ==
    /\ branchEpoch[b] = epoch
    /\ atBranch[b] > 0
    /\ atBranch' = [ atBranch EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1 ]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, branchEpoch >>

Receive(b) ==
    /\ inTransit > 0
    /\ atBranch' = [ atBranch EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1 ]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, branchEpoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << atBranch, inTransit, branchEpoch >>

Sync(b) ==
    /\ branchEpoch[b] < epoch
    /\ branchEpoch' = [ branchEpoch EXCEPT ![b] = epoch ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << atBranch, inTransit, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Ship(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Receive(b)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Sync(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved ==
    SumF(atBranch, Branches) + inTransit = Total
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Branches = {1, 2}
    Total = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A blood-bank network moves units of blood among branches, and no unit is ever created or destroyed: the total across all branches plus whatever is currently in transit between them is invariant. Shipping a unit out of a branch removes it from that branch and places it in transit; receiving a unit at a branch takes it out of transit and adds it there. Routing is governed by an epoch number: an epoch-numbered reconfiguration re-plans the network, and a branch may only ship under the current epoch, so a branch must be synced to the latest epoch before it can send. Branches can be slow -- a straggler may lag several epochs behind before syncing -- but none ever fails; a lagging branch always remains able to sync and then participate. Receiving is always permitted. The network must preserve conservation: the units summed over all branches, plus the units in transit, always equal the fixed network total.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of blood units summed over all branches plus the units in transit always equals the fixed network total, so no unit is ever created or destroyed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p1t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Txns, Participants, InitBal

Delta == [ t \in Txns |-> IF t = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 ]

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ { x })

VARIABLES votes, txnState, balance, journal, admin

vars == <<votes, txnState, balance, journal, admin>>

MaxBal == InitBal + SumF(Delta, Txns)

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [ Txns -> [ Participants -> { "none", "yes", "no" } ] ]
    /\ txnState \in [ Txns -> { "voting", "committed", "aborted" } ]
    /\ balance \in 0 .. MaxBal
    /\ journal \subseteq Txns
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ votes = [ t \in Txns |-> [ p \in Participants |-> "none" ] ]
    /\ txnState = [ t \in Txns |-> "voting" ]
    /\ balance = InitBal
    /\ journal = {}
    /\ admin = FALSE

Vote(t, p, v) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ votes[t][p] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [ votes EXCEPT ![t][p] = v ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << txnState, balance, journal, admin >>

Commit(t) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "yes"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "committed" ]
    /\ balance' = balance + Delta[t]
    /\ journal' = journal \cup { t }
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, admin >>

AdminCommit(t) ==
    /\ admin = TRUE
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "committed" ]
    /\ balance' = balance + Delta[t]
    /\ journal' = journal \cup { t }
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, admin >>

Abort(t) ==
    /\ txnState[t] = "voting"
    /\ \E p \in Participants : votes[t][p] = "no"
    /\ txnState' = [ txnState EXCEPT ![t] = "aborted" ]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, balance, journal, admin >>

ToggleAdmin ==
    /\ admin' = ~admin
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, txnState, balance, journal >>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Participants, v \in { "yes", "no" } : Vote(t, p, v)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AdminCommit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Abort(t)
    \/ ToggleAdmin

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    balance = InitBal + SumF(Delta, journal)
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Txns = {1, 2}
    Participants = {1, 2}
    InitBal = 0
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker applies cross-branch transfers as two-phase-commit transactions, each moving a fixed number of units and coordinated across the participating branches. In the voting phase each participant votes yes or no on a transaction. A transaction commits only when every participant has voted yes, and committing is atomic: the shared inventory balance is increased by that transaction's delta and the transaction id is recorded in a durable journal in the same step, so a committed update can never be lost. A transaction aborts if any participant votes no, changing nothing. A privileged administrator may override the vote and force a pending transaction to commit directly, but the override obeys the same atomic discipline -- it applies the delta and journals the transaction together. The admin channel can be toggled on and off. The tracker must guarantee that no committed update is ever lost: the shared balance always equals the base level plus the summed deltas of exactly the transactions recorded in the journal.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared inventory balance always equals the base level plus the sum of the deltas of the transactions recorded in the durable journal, so no committed update is ever lost.
